Extend a curve on a surface

**Panel:** Comma → Curve · **Nickname:** `ExtOnSrf`

## Inputs

| Curve | `C` | Curve | Item |  | Curve to extend |
| Surface | `S` | Surface | Item |  | Surface for extend operation |
| CurveEnd | `CE` | Integer | Item | `3` | Right-click to select curve end type<br>Options: None; Start; End; Both |
